Summary for English readers:
Liu Pingzhi was a family man with a wife and a son, but his life ended abruptly in a war. Then, he gets reincarnated as a girl named Lin Ling (affectionately called Ling Ling). Lucky for him, he still keep all the memories from his past life.
Fast forward to when Ling Ling is 12: she crosses paths with her former wife. the wife assumes this little girl is just interested in their son, Liu Yue, and decides to train Ling Ling to be the perfect wife for him. From there, the story follows Ling Ling’s interactions with the people who were once her own family.
The real drama kicks in when Ling Ling and Liu Yue turn 16. Noticing her former son getting roasted by the local village boys for being single, Ling Ling decides to intervene. To shut them up and piss them off, she pretends to be Liu Yue’s wife. One of the guys takes the bait a bit too hard, he tries to get revenge on her later, but luckily, Liu Yue swoops in to save the day. This is the moment she realizes: she’s no longer the man named Liu Pingzhi; that guy is long dead. Now she’s just a physically weak teenage girl, it’s finally time to let the past go.
After accepting her new life, she officially becomes Liu Yue’s girlfriend. He eventually pops the question, they get married, and, like any pair of horny newlyweds, they start banging everywhere to ensure the family line continues. Thanks to their non-stop efforts, they eventually have a son and live happily ever after! The end.
